candidates.change_summary: Replace the selfdestruct target to always send remaining funds to the contract owner (smartfix_owner) instead of msg.sender.
Remove the require check so anyone can call and trigger selfdestruct, changing who can cause contract destruction.
Invert the require condition so that only callers who are NOT the owner can call and trigger selfdestruct.
Change the selfdestruct recipient from msg.sender to the zero address (payable(0)), causing Ether to be irrecoverably burned on destruction.
Swap order of statements: perform selfdestruct before the require (note: will revert if require executes after but here it changes execution path), altering observable behavior.
